g.text: Half of rural KP earners make Rs 187,200 a year or less; the top tenth make Rs 456,000 or more
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household files. Sample: earners aged 15-64 with earnings > 0 in rural Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) (n = 3,396).
Weighted by household weight (hhweight). 13 earners outside Rs 10,000 - Rs 10,000,000 are excluded from the histogram.
